create_payoff_matrix_component: create a PayoffMatrix component to compute game payoffs for multiple players using action-to-scores callbacks
build_payoff_matrix_with_callbacks: build a PayoffMatrix instance with custom action_to_scores and scores_to_observation callable functions
reset_payoff_matrix_stages: reset the PayoffMatrix component to clear stage index and partial joint actions
get_player_scores: get the cumulative player scores from a PayoffMatrix component using the get_scores method
serialize_payoff_matrix_state: serialize and restore a PayoffMatrix component state using get_state and set_state methods
